propositions: The transition command has two separate force flags with different meanings (--force for plan-review gate, --force-close for completion gate), creating inconsistency with rebar claim's single --force spelling.
The --force-close flag must be renamed to --force[=<reason>] with no deprecation alias, and stale invocations must fail loudly rather than silently.
The parser's hand-rolled flag loop silently skips unknown tokens, so explicit rejection of --force-close is required to prevent it becoming a silent no-op bypass.
Concurrent changes after the rename landed introduced stale --force-close references in scripts/dependency_audit.py that broke at runtime when the rejecting branch fired.

Tree-wide grep validation at plan-review time was insufficient to catch post-merge emitters of the retired flag; a regression test feeding the generated argv to the real parser prevents future reintroductions.
